metadata.name: Smart English Vocabulary Test Dataset
metadata.description: A test vocabulary dataset for an intelligent personalized English learning platform.

meanings.en: to leave someone or something completely and not come back

example_sentences.en: He abandoned his plan to travel abroad.
example_sentences.zh: 他放弃了出国旅行的计划。

words.memory_tip: a-(加强) + bandon(绑)，想象把绑住的东西解开扔掉，即放弃。

meanings.en: the power or skill to do something

example_sentences.en: She has the ability to learn quickly.
example_sentences.zh: 她有能力快速学习。

words.memory_tip: able(有能力的) 名词形式，-ity 是常见的名词后缀。

meanings.en: not in a place where you are expected to be

example_sentences.en: He was absent from school yesterday.
example_sentences.zh: 他昨天没来上学。

words.memory_tip: ab-(离开) + sent(存在)，离开了存在的状态 → 缺席。

meanings.en: to take in liquid, gas, or another substance

example_sentences.en: Plants absorb water from the soil.
example_sentences.zh: 植物从土壤中吸收水分。

words.memory_tip: ab-(离开) + sorb(吸)，海绵吸水把水吸走，即吸收。

meanings.en: based on ideas rather than real things
a short summary of a talk or article

example_sentences.en: The idea is too abstract for children to understand.
example_sentences.zh: 这个想法太抽象了，孩子们无法理解。

words.memory_tip: abs-(离开) + tract(拉)，从具体事物中抽离出来 → 抽象的。

meanings.en: a way of entering or reaching a place
to find information on a computer

example_sentences.en: Students can access the library online.
example_sentences.zh: 学生可以在线访问图书馆。

words.memory_tip: ac-(朝) + cess(走)，走向某处 → 进入的通道。

meanings.en: to go somewhere with someone

example_sentences.en: She accompanied her friend to the hospital.
example_sentences.zh: 她陪朋友去了医院。

words.memory_tip: ac-(朝) + company(伙伴)，去和伙伴在一起 → 陪伴。

meanings.en: exactly correct and without mistakes

example_sentences.en: Please give me an accurate answer.
example_sentences.zh: 请给我一个准确的答案。

words.memory_tip: ac-(朝) + cur(关心) + -ate，对细节很关心的 → 精确的。

meanings.en: to succeed in doing something good

example_sentences.en: He achieved his goal of passing the exam.
example_sentences.zh: 他实现了通过考试的目标。

words.memory_tip: a-(朝) + chieve(首脑)，走向巅峰 → 实现目标。

meanings.en: to get something, especially knowledge or a skill

example_sentences.en: She acquired a good knowledge of English.
example_sentences.zh: 她学到了很好的英语知识。

words.memory_tip: ac-(朝) + quire(寻求)，通过寻求得到 → 获得。

meanings.en: to change to fit a new situation or use

example_sentences.en: It took him a while to adapt to the new school.
example_sentences.zh: 他花了一段时间来适应新学校。

words.memory_tip: ad-(朝) + apt(适合)，使自己适合 → 适应。

meanings.en: enough for a particular purpose

example_sentences.en: The room is adequate for two people.
example_sentences.zh: 这个房间对两个人来说足够了。

words.memory_tip: ad-(朝) + equate(相等)，与需求相等的 → 足够的。

meanings.en: to change something slightly to make it better

example_sentences.en: You can adjust the seat to make it more comfortable.
example_sentences.zh: 你可以调整座椅让它更舒适。

words.memory_tip: ad-(朝) + just(正确)，调整到正确的位置 → 调整。

meanings.en: to like or respect someone or something very much

example_sentences.en: I really admire your courage.
example_sentences.zh: 我真的很钦佩你的勇气。

words.memory_tip: ad-(朝) + mire(惊叹)，对某人感到惊叹 → 钦佩。

meanings.en: to agree that something is true

example_sentences.en: He admitted that he made a mistake.
example_sentences.zh: 他承认他犯了一个错误。

words.memory_tip: ad-(朝) + mit(送)，把真相送到台前 → 承认。

meanings.en: to start using a new idea or method

example_sentences.en: The company decided to adopt a new policy.
example_sentences.zh: 公司决定采纳一项新政策。

words.memory_tip: ad-(朝) + opt(选择)，选择并接受 → 采纳。

meanings.en: to move forward or make progress
progress or money paid before the usual time

example_sentences.en: Technology continues to advance rapidly.
example_sentences.zh: 科技继续快速发展。

words.memory_tip: adv-(前) + ance，向前走 → 前进、进步。

meanings.en: something that helps you to be better than others

example_sentences.en: Speaking English is a big advantage in many jobs.
example_sentences.zh: 会说英语在许多工作中是一大优势。

words.memory_tip: advance(前进) + -age，让人前进的东西 → 优势。

meanings.en: to tell people about a product or service to make them buy it

example_sentences.en: They advertised the concert on TV.
example_sentences.zh: 他们在电视上宣传了那场音乐会。

words.memory_tip: ad-(朝) + vert(转) + -ise，让人们转向关注产品 → 做广告。

meanings.en: an event or situation that people are talking about

example_sentences.en: It is a private affair, so I won't ask.
example_sentences.zh: 这是私人事务，所以我不会过问。

words.memory_tip: af-(朝) + fair(做)，需要去做的事 → 事务。

meanings.en: to have enough money to buy something

example_sentences.en: I can't afford a new car right now.
example_sentences.zh: 我现在买不起新车。

words.memory_tip: af-(朝) + ford(向前)，能往前走 → 负担得起。

meanings.en: an arrangement or decision made by two or more people

example_sentences.en: They reached an agreement after a long discussion.
example_sentences.zh: 经过长时间讨论，他们达成了协议。

words.memory_tip: agree(同意) + -ment(名词后缀) → 协议。

meanings.en: how much there is of something

example_sentences.en: A large amount of money was spent on the project.
example_sentences.zh: 这个项目花费了大量资金。

words.memory_tip: a-(朝) + mount(山)，堆成山一样 → 数量大。

meanings.en: to study something closely to understand it better

example_sentences.en: We need to analyse the data carefully.
example_sentences.zh: 我们需要仔细分析这些数据。

words.memory_tip: ana-(分开) + lyse(解开)，把东西拆开看 → 分析。

meanings.en: very old; from a long time ago

example_sentences.en: We visited an ancient temple in the city.
example_sentences.zh: 我们参观了城里一座古老的寺庙。

words.memory_tip: anci-(前，古) + -ent(……的)，属于远古的 → 古代的。

meanings.en: to tell people something officially

example_sentences.en: The teacher announced the exam results.
example_sentences.zh: 老师公布了考试结果。

words.memory_tip: an-(朝) + nounce(报告)，向公众报告 → 宣布。

meanings.en: happening once a year

example_sentences.en: The company holds an annual meeting in December.
example_sentences.zh: 公司每年十二月举行年度会议。

words.memory_tip: ann(年) + -ual(……的)，与年有关的 → 每年的。

meanings.en: a feeling of worry about something

example_sentences.en: He felt a lot of anxiety before the exam.
example_sentences.zh: 考试前他感到非常焦虑。

words.memory_tip: anx(焦虑) + -iety(名词后缀)，内心的不安 → 焦虑。

meanings.en: easy to see or understand

example_sentences.en: It is apparent that she is not happy.
example_sentences.zh: 很明显她不开心。

words.memory_tip: appar(出现) + -ent，出现在眼前的 → 明显的。

meanings.en: to ask people for help or support
a quality that makes people like something

example_sentences.en: The idea of studying abroad appeals to many students.
example_sentences.zh: 留学的想法吸引了许多学生。

words.memory_tip: ap-(朝) + peal(推)，把请求推向前 → 呼吁、吸引。

meanings.en: the desire to eat food

example_sentences.en: The long walk gave me a good appetite.
example_sentences.zh: 长时间的散步让我胃口大开。

words.memory_tip: ap-(朝) + pet(寻求) + -ite，想吃东西的追求 → 食欲。

meanings.en: to make a formal request or to use something

example_sentences.en: She applied for a job at the hospital.
example_sentences.zh: 她申请了医院的一份工作。

words.memory_tip: ap-(朝) + ply(折)，把申请书折好递交 → 申请。

meanings.en: to come nearer to someone or something
a way of doing something

example_sentences.en: We need a new approach to this problem.
example_sentences.zh: 我们需要一个新的方法来解决这个问题。

words.memory_tip: ap-(朝) + proach(近)，走向近处 → 接近。

meanings.en: right or suitable for a particular situation

example_sentences.en: Is this movie appropriate for children?
example_sentences.zh: 这部电影适合孩子看吗？

words.memory_tip: ap-(朝) + propri(自己的) + -ate，使之成为自己的 → 合适的。

meanings.en: to officially agree to something

example_sentences.en: The manager approved my leave request.
example_sentences.zh: 经理批准了我的请假申请。

words.memory_tip: ap-(朝) + prove(证明)，经过验证后同意 → 批准。

meanings.en: to speak angrily to someone because you disagree

example_sentences.en: They often argue about small things.
example_sentences.zh: 他们经常为小事争论。

words.memory_tip: argu(明亮)，把道理讲清楚 → 争论、辩论。

meanings.en: to plan or organize something

example_sentences.en: I will arrange a meeting for next week.
example_sentences.zh: 我会安排下周的一次会议。

words.memory_tip: ar-(朝) + range(排列)，按顺序排列好 → 安排。

meanings.en: one part of a situation or problem

example_sentences.en: We should consider every aspect of the problem.
example_sentences.zh: 我们应该考虑问题的每一个方面。

words.memory_tip: a-(朝) + spect(看)，看向 → 看到的不同角度 → 方面。

meanings.en: to help someone do something

example_sentences.en: Can you assist me with this task?
example_sentences.zh: 你能帮我完成这个任务吗？

words.memory_tip: as-(朝) + sist(站)，站在某人旁边 → 帮助。

meanings.en: to think that something is true without proof

example_sentences.en: I assumed you knew about the meeting.
example_sentences.zh: 我以为你知道这个会议。

words.memory_tip: as-(朝) + sume(拿)，未经证实就拿过来 → 假设。

meanings.en: the feeling or mood in a place

example_sentences.en: The restaurant has a warm and friendly atmosphere.
example_sentences.zh: 这家餐厅有一种温暖友好的气氛。

words.memory_tip: atmo-(蒸汽) + sphere(球)，地球周围的蒸汽层 → 大气 → 气氛。

meanings.en: to join one thing to another

example_sentences.en: Please attach your photo to the form.
example_sentences.zh: 请把你的照片附在表格上。

words.memory_tip: at-(朝) + tach(钉)，钉在一起 → 附上、连接。

meanings.en: to try to do something
an act of trying to do something

example_sentences.en: He made an attempt to climb the mountain.
example_sentences.zh: 他尝试攀登那座山。

words.memory_tip: at-(朝) + tempt(试探)，向目标试探 → 尝试。

meanings.en: the act of watching or listening carefully

example_sentences.en: Please pay attention to the teacher.
example_sentences.zh: 请注意听老师讲。

words.memory_tip: at-(朝) + tent(伸展) + -ion，把心神朝向某处 → 注意。

meanings.en: the way you think and feel about something

example_sentences.en: A positive attitude helps you succeed.
example_sentences.zh: 积极的态度有助于你成功。

words.memory_tip: att(适合) + -itude(状态)，内心适合的状态 → 态度。

meanings.en: to make someone interested in something

example_sentences.en: The concert attracted thousands of people.
example_sentences.zh: 这场音乐会吸引了数千人。

words.memory_tip: at-(朝) + tract(拉)，把注意力拉过来 → 吸引。

meanings.en: able to be used or can be found

example_sentences.en: Is this seat available?
example_sentences.zh: 这个座位有人吗？

words.memory_tip: avail(有用) + -able(可……的)，可以用的 → 可用的。

meanings.en: usual or normal
the result of adding numbers and dividing

example_sentences.en: The average temperature in July is 30 degrees.
example_sentences.zh: 七月的平均气温是30度。

words.memory_tip: av-(朝向) + erage，取中间 → 平均。

meanings.en: knowing that something exists or is happening

example_sentences.en: Are you aware of the problem?
example_sentences.zh: 你意识到这个问题了吗？

words.memory_tip: a-(处于) + ware(小心)，处于小心谨慎的状态 → 意识到的。

meanings.en: a state where things are equal or steady
to keep steady without falling

example_sentences.en: You need a balance between work and rest.
example_sentences.zh: 你需要在工作和休息之间保持平衡。

words.memory_tip: ba-(两) + lance(盘)，天平两个盘平衡 → 平衡。

meanings.en: something bought for a good price
to try to get a lower price

example_sentences.en: This jacket was a real bargain.
example_sentences.zh: 这件夹克真是便宜。

words.memory_tip: bar(木棍) + gain(获得)，用棍子压价得到 → 讨价还价。

meanings.en: to act in a particular way

example_sentences.en: The children behaved very well at the party.
example_sentences.zh: 孩子们在聚会上表现得非常好。

words.memory_tip: be-(使) + have(有)，使有自己的样子 → 行为、表现。

meanings.en: to be owned by or be a member of something

example_sentences.en: This book belongs to me.
example_sentences.zh: 这本书属于我。

words.memory_tip: be-(使) + long(长)，长期存在 → 属于。

meanings.en: a good effect that something has
to get help or an advantage

example_sentences.en: Exercise has many health benefits.
example_sentences.zh: 运动有很多健康益处。

words.memory_tip: bene(好) + fit(做)，做好的事情 → 好处。

meanings.en: to make someone feel worried or upset

example_sentences.en: Don't bother him while he is working.
example_sentences.zh: 他工作时不要打扰他。

words.memory_tip: bo(烦) + ther，让人烦 → 打扰。

meanings.en: a line that marks the edge of an area

example_sentences.en: The river forms the boundary between the two countries.
example_sentences.zh: 这条河形成了两国之间的边界。

words.memory_tip: bound(边界) + -ary(地方)，边界的地方 → 边界。

meanings.en: a plan of how to spend money

example_sentences.en: We need to plan our monthly budget carefully.
example_sentences.zh: 我们需要仔细规划每月的预算。

words.memory_tip: budg(皮包) + -et(小)，古代用小皮包装钱 → 预算。

meanings.en: something heavy or difficult to deal with

example_sentences.en: The high cost of rent is a burden for many students.
example_sentences.zh: 高昂的房租对许多学生来说是一个负担。

words.memory_tip: burd(搬运)，搬重物 → 负担。

meanings.en: a planned set of actions to achieve something

example_sentences.en: The school started a campaign to save water.
example_sentences.zh: 学校发起了一场节水运动。

words.memory_tip: camp(田野) + -aign，田野上的活动 → 运动。

meanings.en: having the ability to do something

example_sentences.en: She is capable of solving this problem.
example_sentences.zh: 她有能力解决这个问题。

words.memory_tip: cap(拿) + -able(能……的)，能拿住的 → 有能力的。

meanings.en: to catch someone or something

example_sentences.en: The photo captures a beautiful sunset.
example_sentences.zh: 这张照片拍下了美丽的日落。

words.memory_tip: capt(抓) + -ure，抓住 → 捕获。

meanings.en: a job that you do for a long time

example_sentences.en: She wants to have a career in medicine.
example_sentences.zh: 她想要从事医学职业。

words.memory_tip: car(车) + eer，像车辙一样的人生轨迹 → 生涯。

meanings.en: a group of things that are similar in some way

example_sentences.en: There are several categories of books in the library.
example_sentences.zh: 图书馆里有几类书籍。

words.memory_tip: cate-(向下) + gory(说)，在集会上向下宣布分组 → 类别。

meanings.en: to do something special for an important event

example_sentences.en: We celebrated her birthday at a nice restaurant.
example_sentences.zh: 我们在一家不错的餐厅庆祝了她的生日。

words.memory_tip: celebr(名誉) + -ate，做值得夸耀的事 → 庆祝。

meanings.en: something difficult that tests your ability
to invite someone to compete or fight

example_sentences.en: Learning a new language is a big challenge.
example_sentences.zh: 学习一门新语言是一个巨大的挑战。

words.memory_tip: chall(叫喊) + -enge，喊出来比赛 → 挑战。

meanings.en: the qualities that make a person different

example_sentences.en: He is a man of strong character.
example_sentences.zh: 他是一个性格坚强的人。

words.memory_tip: char(刻) + acter，刻下的印记 → 特征 → 性格。

meanings.en: the conditions that affect a situation

example_sentences.en: Under the circumstances, he made the right choice.
example_sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，他做出了正确的选择。

words.memory_tip: circum-(周围) + stance(站)，站在周围的东西 → 环境。

meanings.en: a person who lives in a city or country

example_sentences.en: Every citizen should follow the law.
example_sentences.zh: 每个公民都应该遵守法律。

words.memory_tip: cit(城市) + -izen，城市里的人 → 市民、公民。

meanings.en: to say that something is true without proving it

example_sentences.en: He claimed that he didn't know about it.
example_sentences.zh: 他声称他对此事不知情。

words.memory_tip: 从喊叫引申而来，大声喊出的 → 声称。

meanings.en: the general weather conditions in an area

example_sentences.en: The climate in the south is warm and wet.
example_sentences.zh: 南方的气候温暖湿润。

words.memory_tip: clim(倾斜)，古希腊认为地球从赤道向两极倾斜影响气候 → 气候。

meanings.en: to put two or more things together

example_sentences.en: Combine the flour and water in a bowl.
example_sentences.zh: 把面粉和水在碗里混合。

words.memory_tip: com-(一起) + bine(两个)，两个放在一起 → 结合。

meanings.en: something you say about a topic
to say something about a topic

example_sentences.en: She made a helpful comment about my work.
example_sentences.zh: 她对我的工作提出了有益的意见。

words.memory_tip: com-(一起) + ment(心)，心里共同的想法 → 评论。

meanings.en: to share information with others

example_sentences.en: We communicate with each other by email.
example_sentences.zh: 我们通过电子邮件互相交流。

words.memory_tip: com-(一起) + muni(服务) + -cate，彼此服务 → 交流。

meanings.en: a group of people living in the same place

example_sentences.en: We live in a small community by the lake.
example_sentences.zh: 我们住在湖边的一个小社区。

words.memory_tip: com-(一起) + muni(服务) + -ty，共同服务的地方 → 社区。

meanings.en: to look at things to see how they are similar or different

example_sentences.en: Compare the two pictures and find the differences.
example_sentences.zh: 比较两张图片并找出不同之处。

words.memory_tip: com-(一起) + pare(相等)，放在一起看是否相等 → 比较。

meanings.en: to try to be better than others

example_sentences.en: Many students compete for the scholarship.
example_sentences.zh: 许多学生竞争这个奖学金。

words.memory_tip: com-(一起) + pete(追求)，一起追求 → 竞争。

meanings.en: to say that you are not happy about something

example_sentences.en: He always complains about the weather.
example_sentences.zh: 他总是抱怨天气。

words.memory_tip: com-(一起) + plain(拍打)，拍打胸脯表示不满 → 抱怨。

meanings.en: difficult to understand because of many parts

example_sentences.en: The problem is too complex to solve quickly.
example_sentences.zh: 这个问题太复杂了，无法快速解决。

words.memory_tip: com-(一起) + plex(编织)，编织在一起 → 复杂的。

meanings.en: to give all your attention to something

example_sentences.en: I can't concentrate with all this noise.
example_sentences.zh: 有这么多噪音我无法集中注意力。

words.memory_tip: con-(一起) + centr(中心) + -ate，全部到中心 → 集中。

meanings.en: an idea or principle

example_sentences.en: The concept of time is hard for young children.
example_sentences.zh: 时间的概念对幼儿来说很难。

words.memory_tip: con-(一起) + cept(拿)，把想法拿在一起 → 概念。

meanings.en: a feeling of worry about something
to be about a particular topic

example_sentences.en: Her health is a great concern to her family.
example_sentences.zh: 她的健康让家人非常担忧。

words.memory_tip: con-(一起) + cern(筛)，一起筛选关注 → 关心。

meanings.en: a final opinion after thinking about something

example_sentences.en: What conclusion did you reach?
example_sentences.zh: 你得出了什么结论？

words.memory_tip: conclude(结束) 的名词形式，最后的判断 → 结论。

meanings.en: the state of something or a thing that must happen

example_sentences.en: The road is in bad condition after the storm.
example_sentences.zh: 暴风雨后道路状况很差。

words.memory_tip: con-(一起) + dit(说) + -ion，一起说的约定 → 条件。

meanings.en: to organize or do a particular activity
the way someone behaves

example_sentences.en: The scientists conducted an experiment.
example_sentences.zh: 科学家们进行了一项实验。

words.memory_tip: con-(一起) + duct(引导)，一起引导 → 实施、引导。

meanings.en: to state that something is true for certain

meanings.en: to keep something in good condition

example_sentences.en: It is important to maintain a healthy lifestyle.
example_sentences.zh: 保持健康的生活方式很重要。

words.memory_tip: main(手) + tain(拿)，用手拿住 → 保持。

meanings.en: relating to the mind

example_sentences.en: Mental health is as important as physical health.
example_sentences.zh: 心理健康和身体健康一样重要。

words.memory_tip: ment(心智) + -al(……的)，与心智有关的 → 精神的。

meanings.en: not very important or serious

example_sentences.en: There are only a few minor problems left.
example_sentences.zh: 只剩下一些小问题了。

words.memory_tip: min(小) + -or，更小的 → 较小的。

meanings.en: to change something slightly

example_sentences.en: You can modify the plan if needed.
example_sentences.zh: 如果需要，你可以修改计划。

words.memory_tip: mod(方式) + -ify(使)，使方式改变 → 修改。

meanings.en: bad or not positive

example_sentences.en: Try not to have a negative attitude.
example_sentences.zh: 尽量不要抱有消极态度。

words.memory_tip: neg(否定) + -ative，否定性质的 → 消极的。

meanings.en: to get something that you want

example_sentences.en: You need to obtain permission to enter the building.
example_sentences.zh: 你需要获得许可才能进入大楼。

words.memory_tip: ob-(朝) + tain(拿)，朝着目标拿 → 获得。

meanings.en: to happen

example_sentences.en: The accident occurred at three in the morning.
example_sentences.zh: 事故发生在凌晨三点。

words.memory_tip: oc-(朝) + cur(跑)，跑向 → 发生。

meanings.en: what you think about something

example_sentences.en: In my opinion, this is the best choice.
example_sentences.zh: 在我看来，这是最好的选择。

words.memory_tip: opin(认为) + -ion，认为是 → 观点。

meanings.en: a chance to do something

example_sentences.en: This is a great opportunity to learn.
example_sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的学习机会。

words.memory_tip: op-(朝) + port(港口) + -unity，船进港的时机 → 机会。

meanings.en: to plan and arrange something

example_sentences.en: She organized a party for her friends.
example_sentences.zh: 她为朋友们组织了一场聚会。

words.memory_tip: organ(器官) + -ize，像器官一样协调运转 → 组织。

meanings.en: to take part in something

example_sentences.en: Everyone is welcome to participate in the discussion.
example_sentences.zh: 欢迎大家参与讨论。

words.memory_tip: part(部分) + cip(拿) + -ate，拿一部分 → 参与。

meanings.en: to do a task or show your skill

example_sentences.en: The team performed well in the competition.
example_sentences.zh: 这支队伍在比赛中表现出色。

words.memory_tip: per-(完全) + form(形成)，完全形成 → 执行。

meanings.en: relating to the body or real things

example_sentences.en: Regular physical exercise keeps you healthy.
example_sentences.zh: 定期体育锻炼让你保持健康。

words.memory_tip: phys(自然) + -ical，与自然实体有关的 → 身体的、物理的。

meanings.en: thinking about what is good in a situation

example_sentences.en: Try to stay positive in difficult times.
example_sentences.zh: 在困难时刻尽量保持积极。

words.memory_tip: posit(放置) + -ive，立场明确靠前 → 积极的。

meanings.en: possible but not yet real
the ability to develop in the future

example_sentences.en: She has great potential as a singer.
example_sentences.zh: 她有成为歌手的巨大潜力。

words.memory_tip: pot(力量) + -ential，有力量的但还没展现 → 潜在的。

meanings.en: to say what will happen in the future

example_sentences.en: It is hard to predict the future.
example_sentences.zh: 未来很难预测。

words.memory_tip: pre-(前) + dict(说)，提前说 → 预测。

meanings.en: to stop something from happening

example_sentences.en: The rain prevented us from going out.
example_sentences.zh: 下雨阻止了我们出门。

words.memory_tip: pre-(前) + vent(来)，提前来阻止 → 防止。

meanings.en: happening before the present time

example_sentences.en: She has more experience than in her previous job.
example_sentences.zh: 她比上一份工作更有经验了。

words.memory_tip: pre-(前) + vi(路) + -ous，走在前面路上的 → 之前的。

meanings.en: a basic rule or idea about how something works

example_sentences.en: Honesty is an important principle in life.
example_sentences.zh: 诚实是人生的重要原则。

words.memory_tip: prin(第一) + cip(拿) + -le，首先拿定的 → 原则。

meanings.en: a series of actions to achieve a result
to deal with documents or information

example_sentences.en: Learning a language is a slow process.
example_sentences.zh: 学习一门语言是一个缓慢的过程。

words.memory_tip: pro-(向前) + cess(走)，向前走 → 过程。

meanings.en: to help something grow or be more successful

example_sentences.en: Exercise can promote better sleep.
example_sentences.zh: 运动可以促进更好的睡眠。

words.memory_tip: pro-(向前) + mote(动)，向前推动 → 促进。

meanings.en: to suggest an idea or plan

example_sentences.en: I propose we start the meeting earlier.
example_sentences.zh: 我建议我们提前开始会议。

words.memory_tip: pro-(向前) + pose(放)，把想法放在前面 → 提议。

meanings.en: to show strong disagreement with something
an act of showing strong disagreement

example_sentences.en: The students protested against the new rule.
example_sentences.zh: 学生们抗议新规定。

words.memory_tip: pro-(向前) + test(见证)，站出来见证不公 → 抗议。

meanings.en: to make information available to the public

example_sentences.en: The article was published in a famous magazine.
example_sentences.zh: 这篇文章发表在一家著名杂志上。

words.memory_tip: public(公众) + -ish，公之于众 → 出版。

meanings.en: to buy something
the act of buying something

example_sentences.en: You can purchase tickets online.
example_sentences.zh: 你可以在线购买门票。

words.memory_tip: pur-(向前) + chase(追赶)，追到东西 → 购买。

meanings.en: how good or bad something is

example_sentences.en: The quality of the food here is excellent.
example_sentences.zh: 这里的食物质量非常好。

words.memory_tip: qual(种类) + -ity，某种类的特征 → 品质。

meanings.en: to suggest that someone or something is good

example_sentences.en: I recommend this book to all my friends.
example_sentences.zh: 我向所有朋友推荐这本书。

words.memory_tip: re-(再) + commend(称赞)，一再称赞 → 推荐。

meanings.en: to know someone or something because you have seen them before

example_sentences.en: I didn't recognize her at first.
example_sentences.zh: 我一开始没认出她来。

words.memory_tip: re-(再) + cogn(知道) + -ize，再次知道 → 认出。

meanings.en: something that can be used to help you

example_sentences.en: The library has many useful resources for students.
example_sentences.zh: 图书馆有许多对学生有用的资源。

words.memory_tip: re-(再) + source(来源)，可以一再使用的来源 → 资源。
